nodes.label: Release gate: sensitive customer/order screenshots and unverified identity images removed from working tree, but deletion does not remove bytes from existing commits/forks/clones/caches until coordinated history remediation is completed and owner-verified

Before rewriting history: identify affected paths, revoke/rotate exposed credentials, inventory every remote/fork/clone/PR/artifact/backup, notify collaborators and freeze merges, obtain explicit owner approval for a destructive rewrite

Coordinated procedure: fresh mirror clone, reviewed path list, git filter-repo, verify rewritten object database, force-push every branch/tag, invalidate old artifacts, require re-clones, scan full history for residual sensitive blobs
